texts.text: Neutral surfaces. Blue for actions and selection.
Select a node → More → Transfer history
Icon actions have tooltips, accessible names and visible focus.
Linear motion. About 12% of the path.
Static track + a short recovery sheet.
The loop shows activity. It never implies a real completion percentage.
Trust, reachability and interaction are independent
ACTIVE / REVOKED is device authorization. ACTIVE does not prove the device is online.
Online / Offline / Connecting is derived from reachability. Cloud is a storage capability.
Hover / Focus / Selected / Drop allowed / Drop blocked is local UI state, never a server status.
Offline targets may offer explicit asynchronous storage; online-only drops stay blocked.
A drag gesture freezes node positions. The hit target extends 24px beyond the node radius.
Do not send. Apply the server cancellation.
Acceptance is not a delivery receipt.
One activity segment. Reverse for receive.
Only this state can resume the same task.
Start a new attempt. Do not resume FAILED.
Respect the actor; do not auto resend.
New request only if the file is still valid.
Success marker belongs to the receiver.
Drop stages files; Send creates the request.
Latest version wins. Never invent success.
Source: devices.go / transfer.go / tasks.go / p2p.go / pull.go / SQL migrations 001, 003, 005.
Server state, reachability and local interaction are separate dimensions. No new backend enums.
Send a new request when you’re ready.

Enter / change: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1). Exit: cubic-bezier(.4, 0, 1, 1). Arc follows confirmed bytes.
No bounce, orbiting controls, repeated glow or looping progress segment. Hidden pages stop transitions.
State updates interrupt the old transition. Stable node IDs preserve position and focus; stale versions cannot show success.
Success requires a delivery receipt or verified P2P completion. Upload completion only means stored, not delivered.
Progress is data. Activity is motion.
Main: two nodes and one 3px curve. Blue = acknowledged bytes; gray = remaining bytes.
Click curve / either node. Desktop modal / mobile bottom sheet. All numbers and controls live here.
floor(acknowledged_bytes / total_bytes × 100). Byte counts use one consistent basis.
Unknown total has no percentage or ETA. Empty known file waits for verification; never divide by zero.
100% means bytes acknowledged. Receipt / verified completion unlocks Delivered or Received.
Sealed upload means Stored in cloud. It never implies recipient delivery.
Use a 3–8s active sample window; show only after stable throughput. Hide on pause / stale data.
Snapshot has state_version + progress_revision + sampled_at. Reject stale progress and terminal regressions.
Freeze byte progress. Remove throughput / ETA. Resume keeps the same task and starts new samples.
Sum acknowledged bytes / total bytes. Do not average per-file percentages. Retry is a new attempt.
Blue extent follows bytes ≤180ms. Soft 1600ms light pass stays clipped inside the blue arc.
Progressbar gets actual value. State / 10% milestones announced; no per-frame announcements.
This page supersedes the activity-only transfer screens in v14 / v15.
All three share the same 62.5% acknowledged bytes. Only the light pass changes.
1600ms linear pass · 3px width · no moving progress boundary · light stays inside acknowledged arc
Pause: fade light 80ms. Resume: fade in 120ms. Confirming / hidden / reduced motion: no light pass.

An authorized cloud copy or verified local bookmark exists. Restore / Send again follows capabilities.
This transfer has no retained reusable copy. Keep its record; Choose files starts a new transfer.
The retained copy passed expiry. Keep the record; Restore / Keep available is unavailable.
A logical source for this restore, not a peer device or presence claim. Show only for an authorized copy.
Availability and retention policy are independent. A temporary copy can be reusable until expiry.
Explicit promotion before expiry, with ownership / quota / entitlement checks. No invented pricing.
Create a fresh PullSession. Cloud → this device uses the accepted blue arc / bounded light motion.
Restored requires local decrypt / integrity checks and commit. 100% alone is not success.
A past receipt is not permission to fetch again. Re-check grants, copy state and encrypted envelope.
Remove record and Delete cloud copy are separate operations with explicit wording.
Commercial entitlements decide capabilities; never turn a missing or expired copy into a purchasable restore.
